steps.name: stage
argv:
import hashlib, os, shutil, yaml
CANDIDATES = [r"C:\banyan-farm\lora-sapling-v2-0822\src",
              r"C:\banyan-farm\banyan-city"]
REL = "pipeline/lora/manifest-sapling-v2.yaml"
repo = next((c for c in CANDIDATES if os.path.exists(os.path.join(c, REL))), None)
if repo is None:
    raise SystemExit("NO DATASET ROOT. Tried:\n  " + "\n  ".join(CANDIDATES))
print("dataset root:", repo)
man  = yaml.safe_load(open(os.path.join(repo, REL), encoding="utf-8"))
if man.get("trigger") != "bnysapling":
    raise SystemExit("manifest trigger is %r, not bnysapling" % man.get("trigger"))
dst  = r"C:\banyan-farm\lora-sapling-v2-0822\img\2_bnysapling"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(r"C:\banyan-farm\lora-sapling-v2-0822\out", exist_ok=True)
n = 0
for f in man["frames"]:
    src = os.path.join(repo, f["image"])
    got = hashlib.sha256(open(src, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
    if got != f["sha256"]:
        raise SystemExit("SHA MISMATCH %s\n  manifest %s\n  on disk  %s"
                         % (f["image"], f["sha256"], got))
    # The item-18 scope check, per frame and in code rather than in prose:
    # the manifest must assert an SDXL chain for this exact frame. An LTX
    # still cannot claim it, and a frame with no provenance line stops here.
    if "animagine-xl-3.1" not in (f.get("render") or ""):
        raise SystemExit("NO SDXL PROVENANCE on %s: render=%r"
                         % (f["image"], f.get("render")))
    stem = os.path.basename(f["caption_file"])[:-4]
    shutil.copy2(src, os.path.join(dst, stem + ".png"))
    shutil.copy2(os.path.join(repo, f["caption_file"]), os.path.join(dst, stem + ".txt"))
    n += 1
# The sampler travels with the dataset, from the SAME root, so step 3 cannot
# end up running a different revision of it than this step verified.
shutil.copy2(os.path.join(repo, "pipeline/lora/sample_lora.py"),
             r"C:\banyan-farm\lora-sapling-v2-0822\sample_lora.py")
print("staged", n, "image+caption pairs ->", dst)
print("repeat 2 x %d frames = %d images/epoch" % (n, 2 * n))
raise SystemExit(0 if n == man["count"] else 1)

steps.name: publish
argv:
import glob, hashlib, os, shutil
dst = r"C:\banyan-farm\courier-box\farm-out\lora-sapling-0822"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
src = sorted(glob.glob(r"C:\banyan-farm\lora-sapling-v2-0822\out\*.safetensors")
             + glob.glob(r"C:\banyan-farm\lora-sapling-v2-0822\out\SAMPLE-*.png")
             + glob.glob(r"C:\banyan-farm\lora-sapling-v2-0822\out\SAMPLE-*.meta.yaml"))
lines = []
for f in src:
    shutil.copy2(f, dst)
    with open(os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(f)), "rb") as fh:
        lines.append(hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest() + "  " + os.path.basename(f))
with open(os.path.join(dst, "lora-sapling-0822.sha256"), "w", newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
print("published", len(src), "file(s) ->", dst)
raise SystemExit(0 if len(src) >= 4 else 1)
